mistake_reason: At step 10, the orchestrator lost the conversation history (FM-1.4) and reset the task as if starting fresh, changing the objective from identifying the writer to identifying the publication. This context amnesia disregarded the previously confirmed writer (Annie Levin) and led the team to report the publication (The New York Observer) as the writer, producing the wrong final answer.
